newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator slumps to 580c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator slumps to 580c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market dropped sharply at auctions in Newcastle and Melbourne, ending nine cents a kg lower at 580 cents, Wool International (WI) said on Tuesday.
In merinos, 19 and 20 micron each fell 17 cents, a fall of two percent.
The 21m indicator was one percent cheaper, while 22/25 microns were 1.5 percent cheaper.
In crossbreds, 27m was slightly dearer, while 28 micron was slightly cheaper.
Cardings were cheaper across all categories.
Trade compeition mostly came from Western Europe, China and Japan, with good supprt from Italy, WI said.
Of the 22,453 bales offered, 11.1 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Wednesday in Newcastle, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 39,800 bales on offer.
